additional.name: NVIDIA OpenShell
additional.documented: Runtime sandbox policy, credential mediation, egress controls and auditing
additional.implication: DELIA no puede diferenciarse por sandbox/kill-switch o bloqueo de egress.

additional.name: NVIDIA Agent Policy Fabric
additional.documented: Separates enforcement/runtime boundary and policy decision service
additional.implication: La integración entre políticas y runtime también tiene un competidor; interoperar.

additional.name: APort
additional.documented: AI Agent Passport, pre-action policies and signed decisions
additional.implication: No inventar nombre comercial Agent Passport ni decir que firma de decisiones es exclusivo.

additional.name: ContractOps by Kopilot
additional.documented: CI contracts, scenarios, release gates, drift and reliability budgets
additional.implication: El nombre ContractOps ya se utiliza; no registrarlo ni reclamar exclusividad sin due diligence.

additional.name: EcoKure Assurance Fabric
additional.documented: Deterministic checks, signed evidence, replayable contract checks
additional.implication: Gates + evidence + verifier no son un concepto exclusivo.

additional.name: Arcade
additional.documented: Auth, scopes, tool execution, governance, broad tool catalog
additional.implication: Un catálogo de conectores y permisos no basta como ventaja.

additional.name: Aembit
additional.documented: Blended user+agent identity, secretless short-lived credentials and policy
additional.implication: IAM de agentes especializado ya existe, conviene integrar.

additional.name: Astrix / Cisco
additional.documented: Discovery, NHI graph and agent access governance; no new standalone sales since June 30 2026
additional.implication: Estado comercial importa: comparar con Cisco, no presentar Astrix como startup independiente.

additional.name: Noma Security
additional.documented: Discovery, policy enforcement and runtime security using existing gateways
additional.implication: La superposición sin reemplazar gateway está ya comercializada.

additional.name: Zenity
additional.documented: Agent discovery, identity, policy and runtime defense
additional.implication: La gobernanza transversal está disputada por empresas financiadas.

additional.name: Agent Control
additional.documented: Policy control with allow/deny/steer/warn and SDK hooks
additional.implication: Delia debe competir con paquete de pruebas de proceso y costo, no por API de allow/deny.

additional.name: LangSmith
additional.documented: Trajectory-level evaluations, online/offline tests, human review and tracing
additional.implication: Evals y regresión tampoco son exclusivos; concentrarse en efecto empresarial.

additional.name: Arize Phoenix
additional.documented: Open-source OpenTelemetry tracing and evaluator workflows

additional.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
additional.documented: Input/output and function-tool guardrails, approvals and traces; limits for hosted tools noted
additional.implication: Foco en cobertura entre frameworks, casos negativos y fallos específicos.

additional.name: Amazon Bedrock Automated Reasoning
additional.documented: Logic-backed policy checks; limited to defined variables, English US, detect mode
additional.implication: No decir que verificar políticas formales no existe; analizar tradeoffs regionales y alcance.

additional.name: F5 AI Guardrails
additional.documented: Runtime AI policies and red-team services for enterprises
additional.implication: No competir por plataforma de seguridad completa a corto plazo.

additional.name: NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails
additional.implication: Complementar con contratos de negocio y evidencia real.

additional.name: Braintrust
additional.documented: Evals, tracing and iterative agent quality measurement
additional.implication: Calidad de observabilidad/evals no es barrera competitiva suficiente.
